name: hatch
description: Stack-agnostic, ad-hoc orchestration framework. hatch synthesizes a binder of work items (hatch-plan) and delivers it in parallel waves onto a per-binder integration branch (hatch-deliver), building each item in an isolated git worktree (hatch-build) and verifying it against its own acceptance check — behavioral (hatch-verify) or visual (hatch-validate). Works across stacks (frontend, backend, CLI, data, IaC, …) while keeping deep frontend support: component/icon/token mapping, DTCG conformance, and a design-validation loop.

interface.shortDescription: Synthesize a binder and deliver it in parallel waves, gated by acceptance checks.
interface.longDescription: hatch packages five stack-agnostic orchestration skills, a bundled plain-language writing standard (hatch-plainlanguage), and five agents — three read-only gates (hatch-acceptance-reviewer, hatch-safety-auditor, hatch-design-reviewer) and two opt-in writers (hatch-doc-gardner, hatch-kaizen). hatch-plan synthesizes a validated binder of work items; hatch-deliver builds them in parallel waves onto a per-binder integration branch; hatch-build implements one item in an isolated worktree; hatch-verify (behavioral) and hatch-validate (visual) are the acceptance gates. Stack-agnostic across frontend, backend, CLI, data, and IaC, while keeping deep frontend support (component/token mapping, DTCG, design validation).
defaultPrompt: Synthesize a hatch binder for this work.
Deliver this binder in parallel waves.
Validate this running view against the design.
